items.title: With the elmination of the L.A. Dodgers, the Los Angeles Lakers 3-peat from 2000-2002 remains the last time a team in the major American league has accomplished such a feat - and there aren't any reigning champions positioned to even repeat.
items.author: CazOnReddit
items.body_excerpt: Yes this is a few days late but the Los Angeles Dodgers join the likes of the 2025 Kansas City Chiefs and the 2023 Tampa Bay Lightning as the latest failed attempts to achieve the ever elusive threepeat, with the Brewers sweeping them after repeated blown leads in every game . I…

items.title: I had my doubts last year about a Dodgers repeat. Had my doubts in March about a three-peat. Winning is hard to sustain. Age catches up. The toll is heavy. Another team finds the breaks you used to have.
items.author: Evan Barnes
items.body_excerpt:
I had my doubts last year about a Dodgers repeat. Had my doubts in March about a three-peat. Winning is hard to sustain. Age catches up. The toll is heavy. Another team finds the breaks you used to have.

That's why I enjoy the ride. Talent on paper never guarantees anything. Respect to the Brewers
